name: broadside
description: Broadside – multiplayer naval grid game. Root scripts for running everything locally; see README.md.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix functions ci && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix functions run build
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix functions exec -- firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-broadside
scripts.test: npm --prefix functions test && npm --prefix web test
scripts.deploy:backend: npm --prefix functions exec -- firebase deploy --only functions,firestore
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm --prefix web run build && npm --prefix functions exec -- firebase deploy --only hosting
